# ClearButton { #anylumino.ClearButton }

```python
ClearButton(
    label='Clear',
    *,
    component_kind='clear-button',
    disabled=False,
    callbacks=None,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Compact clear-style action button.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type     | Description                                                           | Default          |
|----------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------|
| label          | optional | Accessible label or visible label, depending on the component.        | `'Clear'`        |
| component_kind | optional | Internal component kind used by specialized button subclasses.        | `'clear-button'` |
| disabled       | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.                                 | `False`          |
| callbacks      | optional | Optional callbacks invoked when the widget sends an activation event. | `None`           |
